summary: Persistence for the next-year working forecast (management forecast, not the board budget). Adds working_forecasts (one working forecast per community / target year from an approved base-year budget, with policy assumptions), working_forecast_adjustments (human driver entries: one-time, omitted recurring, contract, rate, volatility, each with a written assumption, evidence, confidence, source and actor; normalizations record the line base and as-of date they were made against and obey sign rules) and working_forecast_overrides (human / board override of a line, storing the model recommendation and model hash at the time, the override, reason, actor and time). Decisions are append-only and same-community guarded. RLS on; anon / authenticated get nothing. Additive: changes no existing row. Extends vendor_contracts (executed-contract evidence: execution status detected / likely_executed / verified_executed with confidence and reason, verification provenance, source email message / library document / version, notice date, periodic amount + frequency, dated rate schedule, unit pricing, one-time fees, extracted assumptions, forecast GL account / fund, intake source). verified_executed only through verify_vendor_contract() by a named person against the exact document hash; replacing the document resets verification and bumps the version; vendor_contract_events is the append-only history.

preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('working_forecasts', 'working_forecast_adjustments', 'working_forecast_overrides')

preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'community_budgets'

preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'vendor_contracts' AND column_name IN ('execution_status', 'verified_by', 'rate_schedule', 'forecast_account_id', 'source_message_id')

preflight.name: library_documents exists (contract source document FK)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'library_documents'

preflight.name: vendor_contract_events does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'vendor_contract_events'

expected_changes: Creates working_forecasts with a one-working-forecast unique index, an updated_at trigger and a guard (base budget must be the community's approved base-year budget; identity fields immutable; no deletes).

Creates working_forecast_adjustments and working_forecast_overrides with FKs (RESTRICT), CHECKs (driver set, normalization signs (one-time <= 0, omitted recurring >= 0), base_cents + base_as_of required on normalizations, 10+ character assumption / reason, confidence, source, 64-hex model hash), line indexes and an append-only + same-community guard trigger.
RLS on all three; nothing for anon / authenticated; service_role SELECT, INSERT (and UPDATE on working_forecasts for policy).

Adds nullable evidence columns to vendor_contracts (document_version defaults to 1; rate_schedule / one_time_fees default to an empty array), FKs (library_documents, chart_of_accounts, account_funds; RESTRICT), CHECKs (execution status set, confidence 0-1, frequency, intake source, verified provenance), an index on forecast_account_id, a guard trigger (verified only via verify_vendor_contract(); document replacement resets verification and logs it; GL binding stays in the community), verify_vendor_contract() (service_role only) and the append-only vendor_contract_events table.
No existing table or row changes.

verify.sql: SELECT (CASE WHEN has_table_privilege('service_role', 'working_forecast_overrides', 'INSERT') AND has_table_privilege('service_role', 'working_forecast_adjustments', 'SELECT') AND NOT has_table_privilege('anon', 'working_forecasts', 'SELECT') AND NOT has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'working_forecast_overrides', 'SELECT') AND NOT has_table_privilege('service_role', 'working_forecast_overrides', 'UPDATE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int
